moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-vertigo, written here): Subject layer keeps its screen size while the camera moves z 0 -> +300 (perspective 1100 px) and background layers scale 1 -> 0.6, 2000 ms easeInOutCubic; per-layer scale compensation from each layer's distance. camera/dolly-zoom solves the focal length per frame but only on its own content. (The site's canvas demo scales every layer by 1 - 0.6 x depth, so its subject shrinks too: follow the recipe.) Params: duration (2 s) · z (+300) · scale nền (0.6) · perspective (1100 px).
